title: S3 Uploads
description: Connect the bucket that holds this site's large files. Editors upload straight from the browser to the bucket, so the bucket also needs CORS rules for this site: the Test Connection page prints them.

endpoint.label: Endpoint
endpoint.help: Leave blank for Amazon S3. Cloudflare R2: https://<accountid>.r2.cloudflarestorage.com. Backblaze B2: https://s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com. Wasabi: https://s3.<region>.wasabisys.com. MinIO: your server URL.

region.label: Region
region.help: The bucket's region, such as us-east-1. Cloudflare R2 uses auto.

addressing.label: Addressing
addressing.help: Automatic suits almost every provider: the bucket goes in the hostname for Amazon S3, and in the path for a custom endpoint or a bucket name with a dot in it.

accessKey.label: Access Key
accessKey.help: A key that can reach this one bucket only. Never a root key.

secretKey.label: Secret Key
secretKey.help: The secret for the access key. It stays on the server; the browser never sees it.

prefix.label: Prefix
prefix.help: A folder inside the bucket for this site, such as my-site/. Give each install (production, staging, local) its own prefix: cleanup removes every file under the prefix that this install does not use. Do not change it once files exist.

visibility.label: Visibility
visibility.help: Public: links point at the bucket or your CDN, and the bucket must allow public reads. Private: the bucket stays closed and every link is a signed URL that works for a limited time.

signedUrlTtl.label: Signed Link Lifetime (seconds)
signedUrlTtl.help: How long a signed link works. From 60 seconds to 604800 (7 days).

publicBaseUrl.label: Public Base URL
publicBaseUrl.help: A CDN or custom domain in front of the bucket, such as https://files.example.com. Leave blank to use the bucket's own URL. Used with public visibility only.
